column2: Ha ha ha! You're all white. It suits you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Huff, huff, huff... Phew.{wait}{clear}I'm worn out. I guess we got a little carried away.{wait}{clear}
Come on, let's head back, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Ahh, that was fun. We're being pretty silly, aren't we?{wait}{clear}
Oh well... once in a while is fine.{wait}{clear}Phew...{wait}{clear}
It's been a long time since I laughed this much...{wait}{clear}
You're cheerful again...{n}
Anytime, again...{n}
I'm glad you're cheerful again... A smile suits you, Irene.{wait}{clear}
Huh?! What... all of a sudden?{wait}{clear}
I was worried about you...{wait}{clear}
Yeah... I feel a little better. I can't keep wearing such a pathetic face forever...{wait}{clear}
My sister and Fein would laugh and say it's not like me...{wait}{clear}
If my sister were here, she'd laugh and say it's not like me...{wait}{clear}

I still have so many things I have to do...{wait}{clear}I can grieve later, right...? I have to keep going until the end.{wait}{clear}So, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, if anything comes up, come see me again. I'll be waiting.{wait}{clear}See you...{wait}{clear}
Thanks. I had fun today.{wait}{clear}
Call on me again anytime. I'll keep you company.{wait}{clear}
Are you sure you should say that? You always look so busy.{wait}{clear}
If it cheers you up, Irene, I don't mind at all.{wait}{clear}
I see... thanks. I can't keep wearing such a pathetic face forever, can I?{wait}{clear}
We've got lots of things we have to do, right? I'll grieve later.{wait}{clear}Come see me again if anything comes up.{wait}{clear}
I had fun today. Thanks, ＄＄＄＄＄＄...{wait}{clear}

Listen, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}Even if you find out where my sister is... don't tell Fein...{wait}{clear}Fein is... planning to die... together with her.{wait}{clear}That's how far Fein has thought it through...{wait}{clear}...So if you find out where she is, tell me first...{wait}{clear}
I understand...{n}
Why...?{n}
Thanks... I'm counting on you.{wait}{clear}
...I'm the one who has to do it.{wait}{clear}Because I can't run away.{wait}{clear}
Why... would Fein go that far...?{wait}{clear}
If Fein meets my sister as she is now, he'll despair...{wait}{clear}
